isd.text: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad when Nahiri raises cryptoliths to draw her, and the distortion drives the angels, even Avacyn, mad.

Her corruption spreads across the plane, turning the Falkenrath into batlike monsters, mutating Hanweir into an Eldrazi ooze, warping Bruna and Gisela into Brisela and creating horrors in other colors of mana.

Only Sigarda among the archangels resists Emrakul's thrall, rallying the sane angels, and at the Battle of Thraben Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul within the Innistrad Moon, ending the Eldrazi invasion.

emn.text: Nahiri calls for Emrakul to come to Innistrad, intending revenge on Sorin, and finds the temple she built for the god no longer empty as Emrakul rises from the sea at the Drownyard.

Emrakul acknowledges the devotion of Edith, who merges with her, while Bruna and Gisela become one fused angel proclaiming Emrakul, and Jace sees her for the first time, bigger than the others, with all Innistrad following her.
Nahiri tells Sorin that she brought Emrakul to his doorstep, and Emrakul twists plants, animals and sentient beings into Eldrazi Horrors as she drifts across Gavony toward Thraben.

At Thraben a silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon, though Tamiyo tells Jace that the changed spell trapped Emrakul herself and leaves them unsure what they did.

mh3.text: When Emrakul arrived on Innistrad, even fossils answered her twisted call.
